1. High Knees - 10 yards down and back

Exercise Objective: Develop lower body muscle strength, power, and increased range of motion of the hips

## Procedure

1. Forcefully drive knee upward (-7)
2. Fully extend opposite leg as driving knee is lifted
3. Maintain a flat back with a slight forward lean of the torso
4. Drive arms aggressively in opposite direction of knee drive

## Coaching Points

- Take short, quick steps (the athlete should achieve at least 30 steps over 10 yards)
- Avoid leaning back
- Thigh should be parallel to the ground at the highest point of the movement
- Keep head and neck relaxed throughout the movement
